ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure, there are two AC input terminals on the left, labeled u; a rectangular resistor element is connected on the upper wire, labeled R; an inductor coil is connected on the right vertical branch, labeled L. The resistor R and the inductor L are in the same closed loop, with no parallel branch, so it is a series RL circuit. Then reason: The problem gives f = 100 Hz, R = 60 Ω, L = 128 mH = 0.128 H. The inductive reactance X_L = 2πfL = 2π × 100 × 0.128 ≈ 80 Ω. The magnitude of the total impedance of the series RL circuit is Z = sqrt(R^2 + X_L^2) = sqrt(60^2 + 80^2) = sqrt(3600 + 6400) = sqrt(10000) = 100 Ω.
